selftests.name: transition matrix rows sum to one and are non-negative
lateral filter probabilities are finite and within [0,1]
a GPR flagged failed contributes nothing to the belief
a persistent centre-pass detection keeps the posterior near the pass (|y| small)
bootstrap interval contains the point estimate
releasing everything gives the prevalence as strike rate
value of information is non-negative before the pit cost
exact n for zero events and a 1% upper bound is about 370
reference-target check flags few in-distribution corridors
same seed gives identical lateral truth
